question: What Vad and FCad does acid-washed SD have?
question_long: What volatile matter (Vad) and fixed carbon (FCad) does the acid-washed sawdust (SD) used for co-pyrolysis with coal have?
rendered: According to Table 1, acid-washed SD has Vad = 84.49% and FCad = 11.00%.
